name: The Chaplain (class portrait)
paint: A worn chaplain in a road-dusty cassock-coat with prayer beads round one wrist and a short weapon in the other hand, singing mid-line, eyes up.
avoid: a real church's vestments or symbols · a halo
prompt:
Create an original Project Heaven Cry illustration in HEAVENPRINT. Use the attached approved Original 27 and New Faces
images as the painting authority: expressive ink and opaque gouache, deliberate angular form, selective dry-brush
scumbling, restrained hatching, charcoal lost edges and warm ivory accents. Faces have believable anatomy and restrained
stylization and specific emotional acting. Format: 4:5, 800 x 1000 PNG, one character from the chest or waist up, one
visible action, one specific emotion, one useful setting hint behind them; the eye line about 22% from the top. The class
attribute's pigment appears only as one accent (given in the section). No text, frame, UI or watermark; no real-world
person, brand or recognisable character. The portrait shows:

Paint: A worn chaplain in a road-dusty cassock-coat with prayer beads round one wrist and a short weapon in the other hand, singing mid-line, eyes up.
Avoid: a real church's vestments or symbols · a halo
CAST AND STAGING: A 68-year-old man with deep tan skin, a narrow lined face, sparse salt-and-pepper beard and receding hair tied at nape. Waist-up three-quarter facing left and looking UP, mouth visibly singing mid-line, chest open. Dusty practical CASSOCK-COAT with patched seams, not real church vestments. ONE wrist carries a short strand of plain ROUND PRAYER BEADS; the OTHER HAND naturally holds ONE SHORT INVENTED FIELD WEAPON lowered at side and partly cropped below waist, no firing or target. Natural grip and continuous wrist/handle, no duplicated objects. Warm ivory window side-light, quiet road arch and pack strap behind. No real-faith symbol, cross, halo, wings, book, text or copied reference face.
ACTING SENTENCE: A road-worn chaplain sings while walking onward because the group still needs courage, and feels weary conviction.
Rendering follows the approved paintings: visible deliberate angular opaque gouache brush blocks, broken ink contours, selective dry scumbling, quiet charcoal lost edges and warm ivory focal planes. Believable face anatomy with restrained illustration stylization, no photo skin/3D gloss/airbrush, no oversized anime eyes. Borrow rendering, NEVER the identity/face/pose/costume of a reference person. The final small motif reference supplies only the class's equipment/gesture motif; DO NOT paste its emblem/frame into painting. Vertical 4:5, full-bleed opaque RGB painting, chest/waist-up, eye line approximately22% from top, face/decisive hands/tool central80%. One person, action, emotion, useful setting hint. Preserve natural skin/cloth/metal colors; one dark mulberry #86234E cloth accent is the SINGLE ATTRIBUTE ACCENT, never a monochrome wash. No letters, readable glyphs, labels, symbols of real faiths, real insignia, caption, UI, frame, border or watermark.
